title: Realized integral exceptional transpose shift square
statement: Fix the global finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, a finite extension F of Q_(C.l), separated finite-type k-schemes X,Y and a separated finite-type k-morphism f:X→Y. Let c be a compactification and S the specified constructible exceptional RingSystem of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. For arbitrary finite-Tor constructible integral objects A₀,A₁ on X and K on Y, an ambient morphism a:A₁→A₀[1], and ambient maps v₀:P_c A₀→K and v₁:P_c A₁→the underlying object of K[1], assume v₁; inclusionShift_K = P_c(a); compactSupportShift_A₀; v₀[1]. Then the actual Hom transpose of [def-pur-adic-projection-trace-data] satisfies transpose(v₁); exceptionalShift_K; inclusionShift_(G K) = a; transpose(v₀)[1]. The exceptional shift is the unique adjoint shift induced by the realized left-adjoint shift. No projection, trace, invertibility, or special tensor presentation is assumed.

proof.text: Lift a to the full finite-Tor subcategory by composing with the inverse inclusion shift comparison. The ofComp definition makes S.left shift compatible, so its naturality transports the assumed ambient square to the corresponding left-adjoint square.

Write the adjunction transpose as eta followed by G(v). Naturality of eta moves the source map to the left; naturality of the right shift moves the shifted v to the right; the adjunction unit shift equation cancels the intermediate comparisons. Apply the ambient inclusion and its shift naturality, then cancel its source inverse comparison.

theorem adicExceptionalTransposeShift
    (A₀ A₁ : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory C.l F X)
    (K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory C.l F Y)
    (a : A₁.obj ⟶ A₀.obj⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (v₀ : (PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l F) c).obj A₀.obj ⟶ K.obj)
    (v₁ : (PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l F) c).obj A₁.obj ⟶
      (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧).obj)
    (hv : v₁ ≫ (adicInputShift C.l F Y K).hom =
      (PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l F) c).map a ≫
        ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l F) c).commShiftIso
          (1 : ℤ)).hom.app A₀.obj ≫ v₀⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') :
    adicTranspose D C F f S c A₁ (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) v₁ ≫
        ((adicExceptionalShift D C F f S c).hom.app K).hom ≫
        (adicInputShift C.l F X
          ((S.operation c (.integral { carrier := F })).G.obj K)).hom =
      a ≫ (adicTranspose D C F f S c A₀ K v₀)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
